nodes.label: Verify in depth, end in ensemble
Two formats, one truth + attention matrix
No client/guest/vendor-facing artifact from a Suggestion without accepted/edited HumanReview
AtomRealization of a governance_bound atom requires consent_id + lawful_basis (B6)
Booking->confirmed requires active VendorContract + fits Budget
Engagement->active requires signed Contract + assigned Pod + funded Budget + active Consent
Event->confirmed requires approved EventConcept + funded Budget + secured Venue + granted Permits
scraped/enriched signal on a minor requires guardian Consent + permitting SourcePolicy
Showcase/Referral/testimonial gated by DiscretionPolicy + MediaPolicy + Consent
ProfileSignal usable only with active Consent + LawfulBasis; excluded on withdrawal/expiry
